accepted_claims: On the fixed DVC instance, a dedicated model locate turn was not required to match the fixed-turn official score.
Controller-owned verification continued after a valid tool-budget verification handoff without another implementation model call.
Clear environment failures did not launch a code-repair worker.
Compared with fixed-turn v2, the treatment reduced total tokens by 15.754 percent and uncached input by 24.023 percent.
rejected_or_unproven_claims: The candidate is merge-ready; two candidate-authored function tests failed.
The policy improves general benchmark quality; only one instance was measured and it remained unresolved.
Command-result reuse would help this workload; no exact command repeated in the provider transcript.
The 600000-token ceiling prevents a single settled invocation from exceeding that number; it is checked only between invocations.
next_actions: Bind controller verification to the frozen public test environment before provider launch.
Repeat the implementation-first comparison on a second fixed benchmark instance.
Keep command-result reuse disabled until observation data shows repeated still-valid work.
Do not promote, merge, or release the DVC candidate patch from this experiment.
